title: Gilded patronage
text: A house chapel needs a new roof, a house poet needs a pension, a house library needs everything. Great names are built on giving — visibly.

effects.tpl: Your name is carved over the chapel door in letters a foot high. God and the city both notice. +20 prestige, +10 karma.
The poet's new epic features a suspiciously heroic patron with your name. +8 fame.
